svg.metadata: {"id": "s032", "name": "钟表店", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "认识钟表", "时间", "生活"], "desc": "墨绿墙面挂满各式钟表（刻度与数字位置准确），落地摆钟会摆动，暖色吊灯，适合认识时间。", "stand": {"ground_y": 920, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clocks_big", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clocks_wall", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cuckoo", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "counter", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "grandfather", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pendulum", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "swing", "depth": null}, {"name": "lamps", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#2D5B63", "wall2": "#244A51", "pat": "#3B6D74", "wood": "#B57A4A", "wood2": "#8E5A34", "glass": "#CFEFF5", "face": "#FFF9EC", "rim": "#E3B054", "rim2": "#C98E3A", "hand": "#30363C", "red": "#E2584A", "lamp": "#FFD98A", "counter": "#6E4426", "teal": "#5FB7B0", "pink": "#F2A49A"}}
